haggai.name: Haggai
haggai.role: Prophet who calls the people to rebuild God’s house
haggai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
haggai.importance: His message joins changed priorities with encouragement when the building seems small.
haggai.connections: He addresses Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the remaining people.

zerubbabel.name: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.role: Governor of Judah addressed during the temple rebuilding
zerubbabel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
zerubbabel.importance: The signet ring, a seal, expresses God’s choice of him amid threatened kingdoms.
zerubbabel.connections: Haggai names him as Shealtiel’s son and addresses him with Joshua and the people.

jeshua-priest.name: Joshua, son of Jehozadak
jeshua-priest.role: High priest addressed with the governor and the people
jeshua-priest.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jeshua-priest.importance: His shared task keeps worship and public work connected in the rebuilding.
jeshua-priest.connections: He is Jehozadak’s son, also called Jeshua son of Jozadak in Ezra.

darius-ezra.name: Darius, the Persian king
darius-ezra.role: King whose second regnal year dates Haggai’s messages
darius-ezra.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
darius-ezra.importance: His regnal year supplies the opening time reference. He does not speak in this book.
darius-ezra.connections: He is the Persian ruler also named in Ezra’s temple rebuilding account.
